name: Mecha-Mimi
source:
Kotarou is now living at his aunt's house because his parents have gone abroad on business. He just lives a peaceful life with his old friends and classmates. But one day, he is attacked by a group of two girls on his way to school. 

He is saved by a girl called Yuno. According to her, she is an android his grandfather invented. Kotarou is surprised to hear that and runs away from her. He tries to forget it, but Yuno transfers to his class on the next day. 

"I'll work for Kotarou. I'll watch him anytime, anywhere. I swear I'll be his sword and shield...." Like this, his life changes completely... But he might have been wanting this sort of adventure life...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
由于父母双双赴海外出差，琥太郎如今寄住在姑母家中，与昔日好友及同班同学们过着平静的校园生活。然而某天上学途中，他竟无端遭到了两名少女的袭击。

危急关头，一名叫由乃的少女出手救下了他，并自称是由琥太郎祖父研发制造的仿生人少女。听闻此言大吃一惊的琥太郎撒腿逃离了现场，本想把这段奇遇忘在脑后，谁知第二天由乃竟直接转学进了他的班上。

“我将为琥太郎效劳，无论何时何地都会贴身守护他——我立誓成为他的剑与盾……”就这样，琥太郎平静的日常彻底天翻地覆……不过在心底深处，或许他本就一直憧憬着这样波澜壮阔的冒险生活吧……

[摘自ErogeShop]
